ambient.bit_carrier: B_n = functions from coordinates0..n-1 to binary bits
ambient.coordinate_order: Wire0 is the least significant coordinate; recursive tail coordinate t becomes physical coordinate t+1
ambient.empty_width: B_0 has one empty function and I_0 has one label0; neither carrier is empty
ambient.flip: X_t x toggles only bit t, preserving every other bit; legal t<n. It is a function on bit registers, not a quantum X-gate theorem.

literal_objects.name: G_0
literal_objects.definition: Maps sole label0 to the empty register

literal_objects.name: T_n
literal_objects.definition: For q in I_n and binary b, T_n(q,b)=(q,b xor(q mod2))

literal_objects.name: G_(n+1)
literal_objects.definition: Write legal i=2q+b uniquely. Output head b xor(q mod2), tail G_n(q)

literal_objects.name: h
literal_objects.definition: For every natural i, h(i)=(i mod2) xor((i div2) mod2); no finite-range restriction on this arithmetic function

independent_mathematical_reconstruction.inverse: For a bit register x of width n+1, recover q=G_n^(-1)(tail x), then recover b=x_0 xor(q mod2), then return2q+b. Since0<=q<2^n and b is binary, the result is a legal label below2^(n+1).

statements.statement: For every natural n,q in I_n and binary b, T_n(T_n(q,b))=(q,b); first coordinate q is preserved.
statements.proof: The same q parity is xor-ed twice; binary xor with the same bit twice is identity. Applies also n0,q0.

statements.statement: For every natural n, G_n is a bijection I_n to B_n, defined by the displayed recursion.
statements.proof: Induct on n. Base singleton carriers. Successor composes quotient/remainder splitting, involution T_n, induction's tail bijection, and head/tail assembly. The explicit inverse above proves both directions without extra assumptions.

statements.statement: h:N->binary bits is defined on all natural integers by remainder xor quotient parity; its use outside I_(n+1) does not define off-range G_(n+1).
statements.proof: Each remainder modulo2 is binary and xor is binary; this is a literal arithmetic definition.

statements.statement: For every natural n and legal i<2^(n+1), the head coordinate of G_(n+1)(i) equals h(i).
statements.proof: Unique quotient/remainder i=2q+b identifies b=i mod2 and q=i div2; substitute the literal recursion.

statements.statement: For every natural n, legal i<2^(n+1), and t<n, G_(n+1)(i)_(t+1)=G_n(i div2)_t.
statements.proof: The quotient is legal in I_n; tail assembly in the recursion supplies the equality.

statements.statement: For every natural even i, h(i+1) is the binary flip of h(i), regardless of any register range.
statements.proof: Write i=2q. Then i+1=2q+1: quotient q unchanged, remainder0 becomes1, so xor head toggles.

statements.statement: For every natural odd i, h(i+1)=h(i), regardless of any register range.
statements.proof: Write i=2q+1. Next i+1=2(q+1): remainder1 becomes0 while quotient parity toggles. Since parity(q+1)=flip parity(q), xor changes cancel.

statements.statement: For every natural n and legal a,b<2^n with b=a+1, there exists a coordinate t<n such that G_n(b)=X_t(G_n(a)). This implies exactly one changed bit.
statements.proof: Induct on width. Width0 has only label0, hence no legal consecutive pair. At successor width split on parity of a. If even, quotients agree and S6 toggles the head only; choose t0. If odd a=2q+1, then b=2(q+1), S7 keeps head unchanged, and legal b bounds imply q and q+1 are both legal tail labels. Invoke induction on those tail labels and shift its coordinate by1. In both cases the selected bit differs from its flip and all others agree.
